description: Author live dashboard UI from an agent via the `emit_ui` MCP tool. Emit one of six allow-listed components (approval_card, choice_prompt, diff_summary, progress, metric, agent_card) with JSON props and it renders in any AG-UI client watching the fleet. Use when you want the operator to see a decision, a diff, or a status readout instead of scrolling terminal text. Arbitrary HTML/markup is refused.
